1460	"brothers sitting together." We said once the calculation that
1461	Rav Ben Tsion Abba Shaul, of blessed memory, made: what is
1462	the contribution of a large family to the people of
1463	Israel? He said, notice that usually children
1464	copy their parents. If the parents had two
1465	children, then the children also have two children. With parents of
1466	10 children, the children also have 10 children. So whoever
1467	breaks the path to widen the circle contributes to the generations
1468	to come. So he did a simple calculation. He says,
1469	look, a family
